name: Team
description: The people behind the site: portrait, name, role and a short bio each, as cards or plain entries. A member with a page is clickable as a whole.

columns.description: Members per row on wide screens; one on phones, two on tablets.

style.description: Member chrome: a bordered card with the portrait on top, or none.

roleStyle.description: The member's role. accent: a small accent-coloured line. plain: body-size text in the text colour, as a byline.

layout.description: grid: cards in columns. list: one row each, photo beside text. featured: the first member large over a grid.

align.description: Text and socials from the start edge, or centred.

intro.label: Intro
intro.description: A line or two under the heading.

items.label: Members

imageAlt.label: Photo description
imageAlt.description: Who the photo shows; defaults to their name.

href.label: Link
href.description: Their profile page; makes the whole entry a link.

links.label: Profile links
links.description: Addresses of the member's social profiles, in order; each is labelled by the network its host names (LinkedIn, GitHub, …).

items.description: The people, in display order (Divi team member name/position/content/image_url, Elementor image box).

id.description: Anchor id of the section; the heading gets `<id>-title`.

bioClamp.description: Clamp a long bio to this many lines; the full text opens in a native <details> ("Read more"), no script.

socialLabel.description: Accessible name of a profile link; {name} and {network} are replaced.

a11y: Members are a <ul>; each name is an <h3> under the section's <h2> (an <h2> when the section has no heading), and a linked member's link text is the name. A portrait's text defaults to the name. The section is labelled by its heading when it has one. A member with socials keeps the name link and the social links apart (no nested links); a clamped bio opens in a <details> with the whole text.

pattern.summary: repeated person units: portrait + name + role
